reproducibility_gaps: Repository-level installation documentation is minimal despite the explicit Conda package manifest.
Exact hardware provenance is not documented by the bounded static inspection.
The archived result/checkpoint surface lacks a single explicit paper-to-entrypoint-to-artifact crosswalk.
The Linux-64 Python 3.7 explicit environment is pinned but portability to other platforms is not documented.
Device-control logic is inconsistent across entrypoints: no-cuda options coexist with forced CUDA/device selection.
notes: R3 reflects pinned source and environment, explicit entrypoints, documented mathematics/architecture/training/evaluation, fixed sampling seeds, and bundled checkpoints/results. R4 is withheld because hardware, portability and canonical artifact/result mapping remain incomplete.
